overview.heading: 1. About this service
overview.body: MyVoiceLab (the "Service") is a voice-based AI conversation practice service. These Terms apply to every user of the Service. By creating an account, you agree to these Terms.

prohibited.heading: 2. Prohibited conduct
prohibited.intro: Users must not do any of the following:
prohibited.item1: Anything that violates laws, regulations, or public order and morals
prohibited.item2: Unauthorized access or placing an excessive load on the Service
prohibited.item3: Defaming other users or third parties
prohibited.item4: Using the Service for commercial purposes without permission
prohibited.item6: Anything else the operator deems inappropriate

disclaimer.heading: 3. Disclaimer
disclaimer.item1: We do not guarantee the accuracy of the AI's responses or speech recognition results. Please use them as a reference for learning purposes only.
disclaimer.item2: We are not responsible for service interruptions caused by network conditions or outages of external APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, ElevenLabs).
disclaimer.item3: The operator bears no responsibility for any damages arising from use of the Service.

changes.heading: 4. Changes to or discontinuation of the Service
changes.body: The operator may change the Service or discontinue it without prior notice. We will give advance notice when the Service is discontinued whenever possible, except in unavoidable cases.

revision.heading: 5. Changes to these Terms
revision.body: These Terms may be revised as needed. Major changes will be announced on the Service. Continued use of the Service after a revision is treated as agreement to the revised Terms.

law.heading: 6. Governing law and jurisdiction
law.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of Japan. Any disputes concerning the Service will be subject to the exclusive agreed jurisdiction of the court with jurisdiction over the operator's location.

contact.heading: 7. Contact
contact.body: For questions about these Terms, please contact us at:

operator.heading: 1. Operator
operator.body: MyVoiceLab is operated by an individual.

collected.heading: 2. Information we collect
collected.intro: The Service collects the following information:
collected.item1: Email address (when you register an account)
collected.item2: Audio data (voice recorded during practice; discarded immediately after transcription)
collected.item3: Conversation history (held only during the session; cleared when you close your browser)
collected.item4: Access logs (IP address and request details, stored as Cloudflare server logs)

purpose.heading: 3. Purpose of use
purpose.item2: Providing the AI voice conversation service (speech recognition, AI dialogue, speech synthesis)
purpose.item3: Improving the Service, handling outages, and preventing misuse

processors.heading: 4. Transfers to processors (including overseas)
processors.body: The Service uses the following vendors to provide the Service. All processors are based in the United States, and personal data is processed on servers outside Japan (in the U.S.). The U.S. does not have the same personal data protection regime as Japan, but each company manages data under its own security standards and privacy policies. Please also review each company's privacy policy.
processors.item1: Supabase, Inc. (U.S.) — authentication and data management
processors.item5: Cloudflare, Inc. (U.S.) — hosting and access logs
processors.note: We do not share personal information with any third parties other than the processors listed above.

security.heading: 5. Security measures
security.body: To prevent leakage, loss, or damage to personal data, the Service takes the following measures:
security.item1: End-to-end HTTPS encryption for all communication
security.item2: Authentication and access control via Supabase Auth
security.item3: Immediate deletion of audio data after processing (not stored on our servers)

external.heading: 6. External data transmission
external.body: To provide the Service, the following information is transmitted externally:
external.item2: Text (conversation content) → Anthropic (to generate AI responses)
external.item4: Access logs → Cloudflare (for hosting and security)

retention.heading: 7. Retention period
retention.item1: Email address: kept until account deletion
retention.item2: Audio data: discarded immediately after transcription
retention.item3: Conversation history: discarded at the end of the session
retention.item4: Access logs: follow Cloudflare's retention policy

rights.heading: 8. Disclosure, correction, and suspension requests
rights.body: Under Japan's Act on the Protection of Personal Information, users may make the following requests:
rights.item1: Disclosure of personal information we hold
rights.item2: Correction, addition, or deletion of contents
rights.note: Please send requests to the contact email address. After verifying your identity, we will respond free of charge within 14 business days in principle.

deletion.heading: 9. Account deletion
deletion.body: If you wish to withdraw, please contact us at the address below. We will delete your account and related personal information. When the Service is discontinued, we will also delete retained personal information appropriately.

contact.heading: 10. Contact
